messages.subject: For Martin Sion | Sustainable mobility, government partnerships and infrastructure strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lebatard,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Martin Sion, Chief Executive Officer.

Alstom's sustainable-mobility and rail-infrastructure portfolio depends on disciplined alignment across governments, public authorities, communities and major project partners. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Alstom's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Alstom.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
